_note: PLACEHOLDER economy tuning. Every number here is a tunable placeholder, not approved balance. Rules follow constitution.md (Economy and settlements); see core/economy.gd for how each value is used.
_income: Settlement income = ((base_income[level] + population * tax_per_capita * (1 + building tax_pct)) * (1 + resource bonus + building income_pct) + building flat income) * economic_factor, capped at income_ceiling[level]. Building effects live in data/buildings.json.

taxes._note: Per-capita tax: gold per person per year (confirmed 2026-10-01: income scales with population). Placeholder rate.

settlement_types._note: role: economic / mixed / defensive (constitution: villages economic, castles defensive, towns mixed; cities prioritize economy, fortresses defence). Arrays are per level 1..3. capacity is the population cap of the main building's level (Housing adds to it).

resources._note: Regional endowments (0-5 per region, data/provinces.json) raise economic potential and growth; they are never spent. income_bonus is the fractional increase of base and tax income per endowment point.

growth._note: Yearly growth rate = growth_base(type) + resource growth bonuses + building growth + wealth term + popularity term, applied logistically toward the settlement's capacity (type capacity + building capacity).
growth._popularity_note: STUB: ruler popularity is open in the constitution; it stays neutral (0) and has no effect until designed.

upkeep._note: Army upkeep uses each unit type's placeholder_stats.upkeep times this multiplier. Building upkeep is per building level in data/buildings.json.
